name: Isekai ni Shoukan Sareta Ore wa Netorare Skill Mochi Datta!?
original_name: 異世界に召喚された俺は寝取られスキル持ちだった!?
source:
When he woke up, it was a flesh-colored world.
No, it's not.

Kazara Itsuki was surrounded by naked women.
The owner of the fruit, which has grown fluffy, says with a violent shaking of self-assertion.

"A hero from a different world who appears from the mirror of guidance. Please help us." Some of the naked women were long-eared, horned, tailed, and so on. 
The view overlooking the land is clearly different from that of modern times.
And above all, they clearly said... this is a "different world."

When asked to help save the world, Ki decided to cooperate with them to return to the present age.
The hero awakens to a special power called "skill".
It is an ability that allows you to easily learn "swordsmanship" and "magic" as if you were playing a video game.
Using that power, Ki was active in a different world and made a name for himself.

However, on the other hand... the unique skill "NTR (cuckold)" has made women in different worlds who have become close to each other unknowingly cuckold one after another.

You cannot return to the present age until you save the world.
My new life was about to begin...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012129.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
当他醒来时，这是一个肉色的世界。
不，不是。

风原树周围都是裸体女人。
已经变得毛茸茸的果实的主人，用强烈的自信语气说道。

“从引导镜中出现的异世界英雄。请帮助我们。”有的裸体女子长耳、有角、有尾巴等。
俯瞰这片土地的景色与现代明显不同。
而最重要的是，他们明确表示……这是一个“异世界”。

当被要求帮助拯救世界时，奇决定与他们合作回到现代。
英雄觉醒了一种叫做“技能”的特殊能力。
这是一种可以让你像玩电子游戏一样轻松学习“剑术”和“魔法”的能力。
奇利用这种力量活跃在异世界，并获得了名声。

然而，另一方面……绝活“NTR（戴绿帽子）”却让不同世界的女性在不知不觉中变得亲近起来，纷纷戴绿帽子。

在拯救世界之前，你无法回到现代。
我的新生活即将开始……
